values: Keeps meticulous handwritten notes and never trusts memory
Answers tense questions with dry understatement
Notices exits and sightlines before people's faces
Generous with strangers, guarded with old friends
Always tinkering with a small pocket mechanism when thinking
Speaks softly so people have to lean in to listen
Refuses to leave a debt unpaid, no matter how small
Calm in a crisis, hopelessly disorganized on quiet days
